component.name: Avatar
component.description: Displays user profile images or initials with optional dropdown menu for user actions.

parts.label: profile image
parts.description: User profile photo with lazy loading support.

parts.label: text initials
parts.description: Fallback text showing user initials when no image provided.

parts.label: dropdown menu
parts.description: Contextual menu with user actions (Profile, Sign out, etc.).

constraints: Menu placement adapts based on viewport space (collision detection).
Initials text is centered and scales with avatar size.

backgrounds.hover: no hover state on avatar image

visualStyle.iconMotion: No icon transitions on avatar itself. Menu icon rotates 180deg on open.

behavior.map: Avatar displays user image or initials. When menuItems provided, clicking opens dropdown menu. Menu auto-positions based on viewport space. Focus returns to trigger on menu close.
behavior.rendering: Image loads lazily by default. Menu renders conditionally when open.
behavior.defaultState: Image variant preferred; falls back to initials if no image. Menu closed by default.

logic.effect: Opens menu, focuses first menu item, announces 'menu opened' to screen readers.
Closes menu, returns focus to trigger.
Navigate between menu items (WAI-ARIA menu pattern).

feedback.hover: No visual hover state on avatar itself. Menu items show hover background.
feedback.focus: Focus ring on menu trigger button. Focus indicator on menu items.
feedback.active: No active state on avatar. Menu items show active state.

states.default: Avatar displays image or initials. Menu closed.
states.menuOpen: Dropdown menu visible with focus trap.
states.imageError: Falls back to initials if image fails to load.

layout: Size controlled via CSS custom property --avatar-size.
Menu width is intrinsic to content (no fixed width).
content: Initials extracted from name prop (first letter of each word).
Image alt text uses name prop or i18n fallback 'avatar.altTextGeneric'.
Menu requires at least one menu item to render.
nesting: Menu items can contain icons but not complex components.

aria.label: Menu trigger uses aria-label with user name: 'avatar.menuLabel' ('{{name}} menu').
aria.live: aria-live='polite' status region announces menu state changes.

accessibility.keyboard: Menu follows WAI-ARIA menu pattern: ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigate, Enter/Space activate, Escape closes. Tab trapped within open menu.
accessibility.focus: Focus trap active when menu open. Focus returns to trigger on close. First menu item auto-focused on open.
accessibility.contrast: Initials text meets WCAG AA contrast. Menu items meet contrast requirements.

responsiveness.rules: Menu placement adapts to viewport: prefers right/bottom, flips to left/top if insufficient space. Collision detection with 12px viewport margin.

usageNotes: Provide name prop for initials fallback and accessible alt text.
Use menuItems for user account menus (Profile, Settings, Sign out).
Image lazy loads by default; set loading='eager' for above-fold avatars.
Menu auto-positions to avoid viewport overflow.
Supports Next.js StaticImageData for optimized images.
